description: A real crossword you solve from clues, alone, together or head to head. Plays on phone, tablet, desktop and TV, with in-room voice and video chat, timed scoring and a leaderboard.
author: jengakit

ui.hint: e.g. a space-exploration crossword, a world-capitals crossword, a 90s-movies trivia crossword
ui.description: Real crossword — solo / co-op / versus. Responsive (phone → TV), voice + video chat, leaderboard.

sample_prompts: A space-exploration crossword with planets, rockets, and astronauts
A world-geography crossword with capitals, rivers, and mountain ranges
A 90s-movies trivia crossword with classic titles, actors, and directors
